verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion of customer and investigation data is a fair governance question for an identity, fraud and AML platform that stores entity and event data, so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention periods, deletion APIs, purge controls or any way to verify data deletion. The nearest items (Alloy storing event data, a shared data store across sandbox and production, entity merging) are adjacent behaviors, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure or verify retention and deletion behavior for customer and investigation data
